# learning-platform-core 0.2.0

These browser assets are vendored from `learning-platform-core` commit
`f59614ee0d77f43852f02b1eab6dfb176ddfbc40` (`feat: add shared hub learner UI
primitives`, branch `feature/shared-hub-ui`). They are kept in a versioned
directory so this static GitHub Pages hub has no runtime dependency on GitHub
or npm and can be rolled back to `vendor/learning-platform-core/0.1.0/` with
its own reviewed commit.

The JavaScript and CSS files are unmodified build outputs. `LICENSE` is copied
from the same commit.
